value.rationale: The rank triple is a canonical natural invariant of the two-idempotent product equation over finite fields. Formula determines every stratum for all fields/dimensions and explicitly measures the noncommuting enlargement beyond standard commuting idempotent counts by a nontrivial zero-product correction. This is a complete infinite-family classification rather than an isolated easy numerical special case.
